blocks.text: Our research bridges Indigenous knowledge and Western science to better understand, restore and care for native grassland ecosystems.

Active investigations into seed germination, soil microbiology, fire ecology and the role of cultural burning in grassland regeneration. Projects run in partnership with Moondani Balluk and the Institute for Sustainable and Liveable Cities.

Cultural fire and grassland renewal
Native seed banking and germination
Grassland soil health
Climate resilience of remnant ecosystems
